top_signals.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Close In on April War Peak
top_signals.summary: A diesel-price shock may be approaching Western economies. That's because the industrial fuel sits at the epicenter of freight, agriculture, construction, and heavy industry; soaring prices ripple quickly through supply chains, raising transportation and construction costs, reigniting food inflation, weakening consumer sentiment, and intensifying margin pressure on small and medium-sized businesses. The latest AAA data show that the nationwide average retail price reached $5.69 per gallon. That leaves diesel just below its April…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Lilly to Buy Merida for $2.88B in Autoimmune Push
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Michelle Davis joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Eli Lilly plans to buy Merida Biosciences Inc. for as much as $2.88 billion in cash to expand in autoimmune and allergic diseases, part of an effort to build beyond the weight-loss and diabetes markets that made it the largest pharmaceutical company in the world. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: S&P Weighs Multibillion-Dollar Spinout of Data Unit CapIQ
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg's Liana Baker joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals."  S&P Global is considering spinning out its flagship data and research platform Capital IQ Pro, in a move that could create a standalone firm worth billions of dollars.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
